prompt: 學術討論區回文：哪一句語氣與文法最適合？
options: I partly agree with Maya, but I think she overlooks the cost.
I partly agree to Maya, but I think she overlook the cost.
I am partly agree with Maya, but I think she overlooks the cost.
I partly agree with Maya, but I think she overlooks about the cost.
answer: I partly agree with Maya, but I think she overlooks the cost.

wrong.I partly agree to Maya, but I think she: agree 後面接人要用 with，不是 to；she 是第三人稱單數，動詞要用 overlooks。
wrong.I am partly agree with Maya, but I think: agree 是動詞，不能和 am 一起用，不是形容詞。
wrong.I partly agree with Maya, but I think sh: overlook 是及物動詞，直接接受詞，不能加 about。

why: agree with someone 是固定用法；overlook 直接接受詞；she 搭配 overlooks。
tip: agree with 人；overlook 後不加介系詞。
say: I partly agree with Maya, but I think she overlooks the cost.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: The new data _____ the earlier hypothesis, so the researchers will need to revise their explanation.
options: contradict
contribute
contain
construct

wrong.contribute: contribute 是「貢獻」，不能用來表示資料與假設不一致。
wrong.contain: contain 是「包含」，與「必須修改解釋」的因果關係不符。
wrong.construct: construct 是「建造、建構」，不是資料和假設之間的關係。

why: 需要修改解釋，代表新資料與原本假設矛盾，contradict 是「與……矛盾」。
tip: contradict 後面直接接被否定的說法。
say: The new data contradict the earlier hypothesis, so the researchers will need to revise their explanation.

text: The professor suggested that the study may not be generalizable to other age groups.
options: 教授認為這項研究的結果可能無法推及其他年齡層。
教授說這項研究只適用於所有年齡層。
教授禁止其他年齡層參加這項研究。
教授認為其他年齡層的研究比較重要。
answer: 教授認為這項研究的結果可能無法推及其他年齡層。

wrong.教授說這項研究只適用於所有年齡層。: 原句有 not 和 may，意思是可能無法推廣，而不是適用於所有人。
wrong.教授禁止其他年齡層參加這項研究。: generalizable 指結果能不能推廣，不是禁止參加。
wrong.教授認為其他年齡層的研究比較重要。: 原句沒有比較重要性，只是在說結論的適用範圍。

why: generalizable 是「可推廣的」，not generalizable 表示結論不一定適用於其他族群。
tip: generalize 在研究中指把結果推廣到其他對象。
say: The professor suggested that the study may not be generalizable to other age groups.

prompt: 聽後複誦後，訪談問你：「你如何準備考試？」你想先回答再補充一個理由。哪一句最自然？
options: I review my notes every night because repetition helps me remember.
I review my notes every night, because the repetition help me to remember.
I am review my notes every night because repetition helps me remember.
I review my notes every night so that repetition helps me remembering.
answer: I review my notes every night because repetition helps me remember.

wrong.I review my notes every night, because t: repetition 是單數，動詞要用 helps，而且這裡沒有特指，不需要 the。
wrong.I am review my notes every night because: am 和 review 同時使用，造成兩個動詞，習慣用 I review 即可。
wrong.I review my notes every night so that re: help 之後接原形 remember，不是 remembering；so that 用於目的，不是在說明原因。

why: because 引出原因；help 後面可直接接原形動詞。
say: I review my notes every night because repetition helps me remember.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Neither of the two samples supports the original theory.
Neither of the two samples support the original theory.
None of the two samples supports the original theory.
Neither the two samples supports the original theory.
answer: Neither of the two samples supports the original theory.

wrong.Neither of the two samples support the o: neither of 通常視為單數，動詞要用 supports。
wrong.None of the two samples supports the ori: 只有兩者時用 neither，none 用於三個以上。
wrong.Neither the two samples supports the ori: neither 後面需要 of 才能接 the two samples，否則結構不完整。

why: 兩者都不用 neither of，且其後動詞視為單數。
tip: 兩者皆非：neither of；三者以上：none of。
say: Neither of the two samples supports the original theory.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: To _____ the lecturer's main point, summarize it in your own words rather than copying the sentences.
options: paraphrase
photograph
publish
punish

wrong.photograph: photograph 是「拍照」，與用自己的話表達無關。
wrong.publish: publish 是「出版」，無法連到用自己的話整理重點。
wrong.punish: punish 是「處罰」，語意完全不符。

why: in your own words 就是改述，paraphrase 的意思是意譯、換句話說。
say: To paraphrase the lecturer's main point, summarize it in your own words rather than copying the sentences.

prompt: 線上討論要補充別人的觀點：你想說「另一方面，電動巴士維修費比較高」。哪一句最自然？
options: On the other hand, electric buses can be more expensive to maintain.
On the other side, electric buses can maintain more expensive.
In other hand, electric buses can be more expensive to maintain.
At the other hand, electric buses are expensive for maintaining.
answer: On the other hand, electric buses can be more expensive to maintain.

wrong.On the other side, electric buses can ma: On the other hand 才是固定片語；maintain 在此需要被動意義，應寫成 expensive to maintain。
wrong.In other hand, electric buses can be mor: 固定片語是 On the other hand，介系詞和冠詞都不能換掉。
wrong.At the other hand, electric buses are ex: At the other hand 不是正確片語，for maintaining 也不如 to maintain 自然。

why: On the other hand 表示對比；expensive to maintain 是形容詞加不定詞的常見用法。
tip: 對比用 On the other hand。
say: On the other hand, electric buses can be more expensive to maintain.

prompt: 這句話最可能想表達什麼？
text: The author's claim sounds convincing, but the evidence is thin.
options: 作者的說法聽起來有說服力，但證據不夠充分。
作者的說法很薄弱，而且沒有人相信。
作者提供了大量證據，所以說法完全正確。
作者的證據很有力，但說法聽起來沒說服力。
answer: 作者的說法聽起來有說服力，但證據不夠充分。

wrong.作者的說法很薄弱，而且沒有人相信。: convincing 是正面詞，說法聽起來有說服力，並沒有說沒有人相信。
wrong.作者提供了大量證據，所以說法完全正確。: thin 是「單薄」，證據不多，不是大量。
wrong.作者的證據很有力，但說法聽起來沒說服力。: 把兩個部分顛倒了：說法有說服力，證據才是不足。

why: but 前後對比：說法 convincing，證據 thin。
say: The author's claim sounds convincing, but the evidence is thin.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: The lecture was so long that many students lost focus.
The lecture was so long that many students lost the focus.
The lecture was too long that many students lost focus.
The lecture was such long that many students lost focus.
answer: The lecture was so long that many students lost focus.

wrong.The lecture was so long that many studen: lose focus 是慣用語，不加 the，意思是無法專心。
wrong.The lecture was too long that many stude: too ... to 才成對；表示結果要用 so ... that。
wrong.The lecture was such long that many stud: such 後面接名詞片語，修飾形容詞要用 so，除非寫成 such a long lecture。

why: so + 形容詞 + that 表示結果，lose focus 是固定慣用語。
tip: so + 形容詞 + that；such + 名詞。
say: The lecture was so long that many students lost focus.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: The second passage provides _____ for the claim by citing three separate experiments.
options: evidence
evident
evidently
evidences

wrong.evident: evident 是形容詞，provides 後面需要名詞。
wrong.evidently: evidently 是副詞，不能當 provides 的受詞。
wrong.evidences: evidence 作「證據」時是不可數名詞，不加 s。

why: provide 後面接名詞，evidence 是不可數名詞，表示證據。
say: The second passage provides evidence for the claim by citing three separate experiments.

prompt: 線上學術討論中，你想用 keep in mind 提醒大家這個調查只有五十人。哪一句最自然？
options: We should keep in mind that the survey included only fifty people.
We should keep in mind the survey included only fifty people for.
We should keeping in mind that the survey included only fifty people.
We should keep on mind that the survey included only fifty people.
answer: We should keep in mind that the survey included only fifty people.

wrong.We should keep in mind the survey includ: 句尾的 for 多餘，沒有搭配的動詞或名詞。
wrong.We should keeping in mind that the surve: should 後面要接原形 keep，不能用 keeping。
wrong.We should keep on mind that the survey i: 片語是 keep in mind，不是 on mind。

why: keep in mind 是固定片語，should 後面接原形，that 子句說明要記住的內容。
tip: keep in mind that ... 提醒對方留意。
say: We should keep in mind that the survey included only fifty people.
